title: MORNING RUSH
front_footer: PLAN TONIGHT. RESET IN MINUTES. WIN THE MORNING.
callouts: Lost Time: No routine or schedule leads to wasted minutes.
Missing Info: Important details are forgotten or found too late.
Scattered Items: Keys, lunchboxes, chargers, and more are everywhere.
Last-Minute Search: Scrambling causes stress and delays for everyone.
Late and Rushed: The whole family starts the day flustered.
objective: Create a smooth morning flow so everyone leaves calm and on time.
quick_win: (30 SEC) Do a 2-minute reset: clear the bench, check what's needed, and set out tomorrow.

quick_win: (30 SEC) Choose one item you haven't used recently and decide: keep, relocate, donate, or discard.

Use consistent labels or visual cues.

best_practices: Look for moisture, wear, and damage.
Replace worn items before they fail.

why_it_matters: When the condition of your entryway is obvious to everyone, it's easier to stay organized, find what you need, and fix problems before they grow. Visual control communicates without words.
skill_builder: Create visible homes with labels or outlines.

why_it_matters: When items are stored where they are used, you spend less time walking and searching. Daily routines become faster, easier to follow, and more consistent.
skill_builder: Observe how the entryway is used.
best_practices: Store items beside where they are used.

Reevaluate as routines and seasons change.

Remove or combine what isn't essential.
Test the simpler system with your family.

objective: Contain water, snow, mud, and dirt at the entry point before they spread through the home.
quick_win: (30 SEC) Place a washable tray where wet shoes naturally come off and use it today.
real_world_action: Install the tray by the shoe removal area. Place all wet footwear inside immediately. Empty water after storms and wipe dry.
game_effect: Equip this tool to gain its permanent passive bonus for the entire game.
six_s_lesson: Containment is often easier than cleanup. Prevent problems at the source.
pro_tip: Choose a tray with raised edges and size it for your household. Keep it clean and dry.
maintenance: EMPTY & DRY REGULARLY. WIPE CLEAN WEEKLY.
why_it_matters: Shoes carry water, snow, mud, salt, and debris into your home. A boot tray creates a containment zone that stops the mess at the door before it spreads. Less cleanup. Safer floors. Better protection for your home.
tool_builder: Choose a waterproof tray.
Place it beside the shoe removal area.
Ensure it has raised edges.
Place wet footwear inside the tray.
Empty water and wipe dry regularly.
home_quest_challenge: CONTAIN THE WEATHER CHALLENGE. For the next 7 days: Place every wet pair of shoes or boots in the tray. Observe how much cleaner and drier your entryway stays.
did_you_know: Containing water and debris at the entrance greatly reduces the amount of dirt and moisture carried into the rest of the home.

title: MAIL SORTER
banner: SORT ONCE. DON'T STACK. EVERY PIECE OF MAIL HAS A NEXT STEP.
front_footer: PAPER SHOULD FLOW THROUGH YOUR HOME, NOT ACCUMULATE IN IT.
equipped_tool_note: Stays in play. Always helping. Always ready.
callouts: Mail Sorter: Creates a simple flow so paper keeps moving.
Action: Items you need to do something about.
Outgoing: Mail you're sending out today.
Recycle: Junk mail goes straight to the recycle bin.
Clear Surface: No piles. No stress. No lost papers.
objective: Process incoming paper immediately by giving every document a clear destination.
quick_win: (30 SEC) Create two folders labeled Action and Recycle, then process today's mail.
real_world_action: Install a mail sorter near the entry. Handle every piece of mail as it arrives and make one decision for each item.
game_effect: Equip this tool to gain its permanent passive bonus for the entire game.
six_s_lesson: Work flows more efficiently when every item moves through a defined process instead of stopping in piles.
pro_tip: Empty the Action slot regularly. A full inbox becomes a smaller paper pile.
maintenance: REVIEW ACTION WEEKLY. KEEP ONLY WHAT NEEDS ATTENTION.
durability: BUILT TO HANDLE DAILY PAPER TRAFFIC.
why_it_matters: Piles grow when decisions are delayed. A mail sorter creates a simple workflow so every piece of mail immediately moves to the right place. Less clutter. Fewer lost papers. Lower stress.
tool_builder: Choose a sorter that fits your space.
Place it beside the Landing Zone.
Label each section clearly.
Pair it with a recycle bin.
Review the Action slot weekly.
home_quest_challenge: ZERO PAPER PILES CHALLENGE. For the next 7 days: Process every piece of incoming mail immediately. Finish each day with no unsorted paper on the entryway surface.
did_you_know: Making one decision when paper first enters the home helps prevent small piles from becoming large backlogs.
